beats.say: Ever wonder what happens to your post before it goes live?
Without checks, spam and unsafe words could reach your readers.
Every post moves along a belt with three gates before it goes live.
cite: Every post moves along a belt with three gates before it goes live

beats.say: First, Screening. Software flags spam and unsafe words, and about 88% of posts pass.
cite: Software flags spam and unsafe words

beats.say: Next, Review. An editor checks facts and tone, and around 70% of the remaining posts pass.
cite: An editor checks facts and tone

beats.say: Last, Approval. The owner signs off and picks a time, and nearly 95% of reviewed posts pass.
cite: The owner signs off and picks a time

beats.say: Only then does the post go live.
cite: only then does the post go live

beats.say: So your readers see work that has been screened, reviewed and approved.
Try naming the gate that would catch the most problems on your team.
